biggest_catch: Earnings are entirely variable - you earn only when your images license, and low sellers drop to a 20% Silver royalty tier after a year.
catches: Royalty tiers: new contributors start at Gold (40% of direct sales); Platinum (50%, exclusive content only) requires $25,000 gross sales in 12 months; Silver (20%) if under $250 gross in 12 months
Paid monthly only when cleared funds exceed US $75
You must own the rights or have permission for everything you upload; you are liable for claims on your content
Alamy sets the prices; no exclusivity required (you can sell the same images elsewhere)
Content must be human-created - AI-generated content is not accepted
